description: Data logger with 8 analog inputs, 8 digital I/O and 2 relays, Modbus RTU over RS485 or USB and Modbus TCP over Ethernet: channel values, remote and virtual channels, digital I/O, counters, alarms and logging control
source: Novus FieldLogger Modbus communication manual V1.9x A (Portuguese)

sources.title: FieldLogger - Manual de Comunicação Modbus
sources.note: linked in issue #95; register table and section 3.1

notes: Modbus RTU slave on RS485 and on the USB device port, Modbus TCP server on Ethernet. Functions 03, 05, 06 and 16.
The manual does not give the default address, serial settings or TCP port: they are set with the FieldLogger configuration software.
Every value is a holding register. Floats are IEEE 754 with the high word first. Register 774 always holds 123456.125, which checks the float format.

Analog, remote and virtual channels are also given as signed 16-bit integers (registers 3-10, 32-95 and 96-223); the manual does not give their scale. This map lists the integer copies of the analog channels only.
Coils can only be written (function 05): coils 1-8 are digital outputs 1-8, coils 9 and 10 are relays 1 and 2. The outputs can also be read and written in registers 22-31.
Register 0 holds the first four digits of the serial number and register 1 the last four.
Some registers need a newer firmware: float alarm setpoints 1.01, digital input counters 1.10, integer alarm setpoints (x 10) 1.30.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
